review_text: I have just picked up my new Range Rover Sport from M6 Motors and I am delighted with it. Derek was fantastic to deal with from the first day test driving cars to multiple WhatsApp videos answering any queries I had in the following days and calls and texts with updates on the sale. They handled tow bar fitting and conversion from commercial to passenger vehicle fully and let me know daily on progress. I highly recommend M6 Motors for selection of cars, quality, value and ease of sale including trade in.

I recently dealt with M6 Motors and had a great experience from start to finish. I secured a Skoda Kodiaq that was like new and exactly as described. I was very happy with the trade-in and valuation, everything was fair, straightforward, and transparent. A genuine pleasure to deal with, very customer-focused, with real attention to customer satisfaction throughout.

Bought my first car from M6 Motors, a Mercedes C220. The process from start to finish couldn't have gone any smoother. I would really like to thank Eanna for all of his help, he didn't leave one question I had unanswered. The car was exactly how it was advertised and I couldn't recommend them enough if you are looking to purchase a vehicle.

Bought a car from M6 Motors in Ballinasloe and had a fantastic experience from start to finish. The staff were very friendly, kind, and professional, making the whole process easy and stress-free. They took the time to answer all my questions, were honest and helpful, and made sure I was completely happy with my purchase. The customer service was excellent, and I never felt under any pressure.
